summary: Spec-phase adversarial squad found 6 real defects in the first spec draft, including two sev-4 findings where the drafted fixes were themselves wrong (FR-002 fix was a no-op because the CLI truncates org_roots[0] upstream).
root_cause: Spec drafted from plausible code reading without tracing where the truncation actually happens one layer up.
suggested_fix: Keep post-spec adversarial squads; re-verify each finding live before fixing.

summary: Scope item FR-004 was already being fixed by open PR #3401; designing a second fix would have caused a merge conflict and violated single-canonical-authority, so it was retired mid-spec.
root_cause: No pre-spec check for open PRs touching the same defect/lines.
suggested_fix: Check open PRs (gh pr list/search) against the defect before scoping a mission.

summary: Retiring a requirement mid-spec introduced a self-inflicted ID collision (new C-005 collided with an existing C-005 reference), only caught by a fresh full re-read.
root_cause: Requirement IDs are free-text tokens with no allocator or uniqueness check across the document.

summary: The defect class (callers never threading configured org root/chain into shared primitives) was introduced by #3520/#3525 and left unfixed at multiple call sites.
root_cause: Org-chain widening landed in shared primitives without sweeping all caller sites.
suggested_fix: Sweep all callers when widening a shared primitive's contract.

summary: charter list --all-layers multi-pack display (pack-2+ availability) was deliberately deferred to a follow-up issue.
root_cause: resolve_layer_roots third consumer has a dict[str, Path] one-path-per-layer contract.
suggested_fix: File/implement follow-up to consume the new org_chain field in charter list --all-layers.

summary: resolve_layer_roots widened additively (new org_chain key) rather than changing roots['org'] to a list, to avoid silently breaking a third dict[str, Path] consumer with no test covering it.
suggested_fix: Mirror the effective_org_root/effective_org_roots dual-field pattern for back-compat widening.

summary: Red-first tests for multi-part fixes should prove each half independently necessary (half a alone red, half b alone red, both green) so an inert partial fix cannot pass.
root_cause: A single before/after test on a combined fix would not have caught the Round-1 no-op fix.
suggested_fix: Adopt two-halves-independently-proven test design for compound fixes.

summary: Rebaseline derivation via feature_dir.parent.parent is only correct if execution worktrees never carry their own dossier snapshots; this was undetermined and gated on an investigation.
root_cause: Unclear whether worktrees can produce their own kitty-specs/<slug>/.kittify/dossiers tree, which would read a stale worktree config.
suggested_fix: Make the worktree investigation a hard prerequisite and document the answer with file:line evidence.

summary: Every specify/plan --json invocation printed 'project sync store is locked' and 'machine layout cutover did not publish within the bounded wait' warnings; non-blocking but recurring.
root_cause: Plausibly concurrent missions sharing the machine's sync store (multiple checkouts on one host); not investigated.
suggested_fix: Ledger it if it recurs across missions or starts blocking.

summary: Hand-built .venv lacks mypy, so 'python -m mypy' fails; worked around with uvx --with-requirements pyproject.toml mypy --strict.
root_cause: Hand-built venv intentionally omits dev-only tools.
suggested_fix: Record the uvx mypy invocation in plan Gate Set for WPs to reuse.

summary: Branch-context resolver reports current/target/base/planning_base/merge_target all as the PR branch, with no concept that the branch's real ancestor is another open PR (#3520), so base-branch drift has no home except spec prose.
root_cause: Resolver designed for branches off main, not stacked-PR topologies.
suggested_fix: Carry stacked-PR base drift as a first-class field or surface it to reviewers.

summary: finalize-tasks errored with unmapped FR-004 even though FR-004 was retired; parse_requirement_ids_from_spec_md regex-scans the whole spec.md with no markdown-structure awareness or 'retired' concept, so the retirement notice itself is re-parsed as an active requirement.
root_cause: parse_requirement_ids_from_spec_md (requirement_mapping.py:104) scans any FR-/NFR-/C- token document-wide.
suggested_fix: Add a retired-requirement concept / structure-aware parsing; filed as ledger SK-51.

summary: 'agent tasks mark-status --status done' prints success but writes nothing; stderr carries a swallowed RuntimeError 'body outbox writes require the project_only layout' from sync/body_queue.py. Reproduced by three lanes.
root_cause: Success message decoupled from write outcome; project_only layout precondition silently no-ops writes from worktrees (residual sync body_queue code).
suggested_fix: Make mark-status fail loudly when no write occurs; remove sync-residue precondition from the write path.

summary: WP03's owned_files / lanes.json write_scope omitted a file its own task body (T017) required editing; no WP claimed it (orphaned surface). Commit guard defaults to warn so it did not block.
root_cause: finalize-tasks does not cross-check write_scope against files named in each WP's task body.
suggested_fix: Add a generation-time cross-check of lanes.json write_scope against each WP body's file list.

summary: mark-status reports 'pipe-table row updated' for subtasks whose tasks.md table has no status column, with zero on-disk change; operator has no signal nothing happened.
root_cause: Command's success message decoupled from actual write outcome ('diagnostic that lied').
suggested_fix: Investigate upstream; report 'no-op' honestly when nothing changes.

summary: Extracting a CI job into a reusable workflow (uses: caller) tripped six architectural CI-model guards from one root cause: guards key properties off the caller's inline steps, which move into the called workflow.
root_cause: CI-model guards parse ci-quality.yml job steps inline and do not resolve reusable-workflow delegation.
suggested_fix: Splice local uses: delegate steps into caller at parse time (design B, implemented in _gate_coverage.py).

summary: WP01 declared only 3 guard files but the POC proved 6 guards affected; planning also named a nonexistent test file (test_release_ci_ownership.py).
root_cause: Planning scoped guard surface without enumerating consumers; referenced a file not in-tree.
suggested_fix: Have WP03 own the full guard set; verify named test files exist at plan time.

summary: Guard-refactor work cannot be fully verified locally because docs say not to run the full tests/architectural suite locally; must push and let CI run it.
root_cause: Full architectural suite is expensive and policy defers it to CI.
suggested_fix: Do guard changes as dedicated CI-verified steps.

summary: WP01 was deliberately kept in_progress (not for_review) because 5 guards remained red — honest red-first, no green-wash.

Design B implemented: _splice_local_uses inlines delegate steps; module-kernel.yml dropped from WORKFLOW_FILES and excluded from discover_pytest_workflows to avoid double-counting; a kernel filter-group entry was reverted because it tripped filter-glob-live.
Keep one reusable workflow per job so the caller preserves the job id and downstream needs:; extract packs and doctrine (two legs) as separate module workflows and re-verify the guard set after each.
root_cause: Splice attaches to a single caller job.
suggested_fix: Pattern-work extraction per job; verify guards each time.

summary: Full tests/architectural suite still must run on CI to confirm no frozen-baseline regression after the guard splice change.
suggested_fix: Push and let CI run the arch suite.

summary: Arbiter found a sev-5 defect the adversarial squad missed: FR-001 proposed promoting find_undeclared_requirement_citations, which only fires on zero-declared sections and returns [] on the issue's own repro — would have shipped an inert gate.
root_cause: Proposed gate's trigger condition never matches the mixed-declaration case.
suggested_fix: Verify proposed gates against the issue's own repro before specifying.

summary: Arbiter remedy applied as net subtraction: invented <=2% ceiling, three-bin scheme and exception-approval clause deleted in favor of a frozen shrink-only corpus fixture.
root_cause: Spec invented gating apparatus for an unmeasured risk.
suggested_fix: Measure first; prefer frozen shrink-only fixtures over live corpus re-runs.

summary: Two non-runtime call sites (mission_finalize._validate_requirement_mapping and tasks_mapping_core.plan_mapping) duplicate the runtime core's missing/unknown/unmapped logic and needed separate wiring.
root_cause: Requirement-mapping logic duplicated across runtime and CLI surfaces.
suggested_fix: Consolidate requirement-mapping classification into one canonical core.

summary: C-XXX bare-prose under ### Constraints left out of blocking scope (C-008 option b); broadened heading match would over-match narrative 'constraint' headings.
root_cause: _is_requirement_heading uses substring match; broadening needs a smarter heading matcher.
suggested_fix: Future: non-substring heading-match design with FP re-measurement.

summary: Guards read the new status_facts key via .get(key, ()) because tests build ArtifactPresenceSnapshot directly bypassing _snapshot(); strict indexing raised KeyError and the fix was not applied (STOP contingency).
root_cause: Test fixtures construct snapshots directly and don't include new keys; _snapshot() helper not updated.
suggested_fix: Update _snapshot() and direct-constructing tests so status_facts can be strictly indexed.

summary: _validate_requirement_mapping was at complexity 16 (>15 ceiling); split as a campsite-clean first commit before adding new branches.
Chokepoint rule wording ('serializes the mission') was ambiguous; conservative full-mission serialization chosen at cost of concurrency.
root_cause: Brief wording supports two readings.
suggested_fix: Clarify chokepoint serialization semantics in doctrine.

summary: Folding code-free WPs into others is costly because the dependency gate is WP-level: dependents wait for the absorber's entire scope, not the folded subtask.
root_cause: dependency_readiness_for_wp gates on whole-WP approved/done.

summary: WP frontmatter dependencies repeatedly drifted from tasks.md prose (WP05 missing WP03, WP06 missing WP03/WP05, WP08 missing WP05/WP06) so the dependency gate would not have blocked claims.
root_cause: Chokepoint and data dependencies stated only in prose; frontmatter not derived from or checked against prose.
suggested_fix: Validate frontmatter dependencies against tasks.md Dependencies prose at finalize-tasks.

summary: Settled corpus figures (9/368, 139/368) were measured against an earlier broader prototype; the shipped function measures 1/368; an initial 'corpus drift' attribution was wrong and withdrawn.
root_cause: Measurement done on a prototype lacking the per-line declared-shape skip rule.
suggested_fix: Re-measure with the shipped function before recording figures in docs.

summary: Issue #3396 body cited a non-existent commit SHA (ae7eba9b2) that propagated into the readiness probe and phase brief before being caught.
root_cause: Issue text not verified against repo history.
suggested_fix: Verify cited SHAs with git cat-file before propagating.

summary: safe-commit --to-branch worked cleanly 5+ times; the bare safe-commit (reads stale mission state per SK-15) is the broken path.
root_cause: Bare safe-commit reads stale mission state.
suggested_fix: Use explicit --to-branch; fix SK-15.

summary: plan --json planning_base_branch reports the mission's own target branch rather than the actual branch-off commit for a 'branch from an open PR' topology, so the ATDD red-first base had to be derived manually.
root_cause: Resolver answers 'where work lands', not 'what tip red-first runs against'.
suggested_fix: File canonical-source gap if topology recurs.

summary: A separately uv-tool-installed global spec-kitty (v3.2.6rc1) at ~/.local/bin shadowed the checkout's .venv spec-kitty (rc2) on PATH, producing misleading finalize-tasks behaviour; INVALID_WP_OWNED_FILES_KITTY_SPECS aborts whole command.
root_cause: Stale global install shadows editable install on PATH (CLAUDE.md baseline-red category 3).
suggested_fix: Always invoke .venv/bin/spec-kitty or detect version mismatch; count WPs independently of reported result.

summary: _parse_requirement_refs_from_tasks_md conflates citations with declarations (WP02 credited FR-001 from explanatory prose) and truncates multi-line ref lists (no DOTALL).
root_cause: Sibling parser never received PR #3395's declared-shape scoping fix (SK-14).
suggested_fix: Port #3395's declared-shape scoping and multi-line capture to mission_parsing.py.

summary: No owned_files value for a code-free planning-artifact WP satisfies both validators: kitty-specs/ paths are forbidden, and owned_files: [] yields no ownership manifest so compute_lanes raises LaneComputationError.
root_cause: build_wp_manifests requires truthy owned_files; compute_lanes doesn't special-case planning_artifact.
suggested_fix: Allow empty-owned-files manifests for planning_artifact WPs in compute_lanes.

summary: finalize-tasks real run mutated all 9 WP frontmatters and appended false TasksCompleted/WPCreated events to status.events.jsonl despite reporting failure and making no commit (mutate-before-fail).
root_cause: Writes flushed before validation completes; no transactional rollback.
suggested_fix: Validate fully before any write; roll back on failure.

summary: Shipped plan-template.md line 4 contains 'Feature specification from', seeding a Terminology Canon violation into every mission's plan.md.
root_cause: Template source uses prohibited term.
suggested_fix: Fix packs/built-in/missions/software-dev/templates/plan-template.md upstream.

summary: finalize-tasks bootstrap itself writes the requirement_refs miscredit by default, and map-requirements' tasks_md fallback re-applies it for any WP in the batch; fixing required --replace and excluding zero-coverage WPs.
root_cause: _merge_refs consults buggy tasks_md fallback when frontmatter refs empty.
suggested_fix: Fix the fallback parser; stop merging prose-parsed refs into explicit mappings.

summary: finalize-tasks reported commit_created with status.events.jsonl in files_committed, but the commit lacked the newly appended events (ordering bug: staged before status emission).
root_cause: Auto-commit snapshots status.events.jsonl before status emission appends.
suggested_fix: Emit status events before staging the auto-commit.

summary: compute_lanes collapsed two WPs sharing write scope into one lane and produced a cyclic depends_on_lanes graph from an acyclic WP graph; finalize-tasks still reported success.
root_cause: Lane collapse imports dependency edges from any member; no post-collapse cycle validation. Triggered by encoding a scheduling order as a data dependency.
suggested_fix: Validate the post-collapse lane graph for cycles and refuse success (filed as upstream gap).

summary: implement WP04 workspace allocation failed: cannot auto-merge the recorded planning commit into lane-c because the lane/coord worktrees were on a diverged planning lineage; conflicts in lanes.json/status files that may not be hand-edited; no CLI reconciles diverged planning lineages. implement also wrote meta.json vcs fields before failing.
root_cause: Planning edits landed directly on the PR branch while coord/lane branches held an earlier diverged line; mutate-before-fail in implement.
suggested_fix: Provide a CLI to reconcile/reset diverged planning lineages; make implement transactional.

summary: Both implement entry points were independently blocked: agent action implement refused with stale_analysis_report because fixer passes touched tasks.md after analyze.
root_cause: Staleness detector correct but re-running analyze is a mission-wide action outside a WP implementer's scope.

summary: coordination_branch remedy prescribed by the CLI cannot be performed by any CLI command (doctor workspaces/topology, migrate, mission have no flatten); operator authorized a doctrine exception to hand-edit meta.json. Second first-hand reproduction of SK-01.
root_cause: Missing CLI command to flatten/clear a coordination branch.
suggested_fix: Add a sanctioned flatten/clear-coordination-branch command.

summary: After the SK-01 flatten, implement refused 'WP not finalized' because the genesis->planned transitions lived only on the never-merged coord branch; required a re-run of finalize-tasks on primary.
root_cause: Coord topology routes bootstrap transitions to the coord branch's status surface.

summary: Removing a stale lane worktree is insufficient: implement reuses the surviving lane branch pointer, and --base does not override an existing lane branch, so the stale branch must be deleted.
root_cause: implement consults existing lane branch regardless of worktree existence; --base doesn't force reset.
suggested_fix: Have implement detect/offer to reset diverged lane branches; document that stale lane branches must be deleted.

summary: uv sync/uv run banned by operator brief because re-syncing risks destroying the hand-built .venv (cost a prior mission four rebuilds); baseline run via PYTHONPATH against an isolated worktree; a backgrounded pytest run stranded and had to be re-run in foreground (264s).
root_cause: Hand-built venv fragile under uv sync; background runs strand.
suggested_fix: Run baselines in foreground; use PYTHONPATH=<worktree>/src substitution.

summary: move-task WP04 --to approved refused by _guard_issue_matrix (no force bypass) because issue-matrix had unresolved entries; scanner required rows for issues not in the operator list; deferred-with-followup evidence_ref must contain #NNN or 'Follow-up:'.
root_cause: Issue-matrix guard applies at WP approval, not only mission done; evidence handle check is lexical.
suggested_fix: Document the requirement earlier in the workflow; issue-verdict CLI help location mismatch (agent issue-verdict vs agent tasks issue-verdict).

summary: Every mission-branch state write (e.g. WP approval) makes open lane branches stale on shared kitty-specs artifacts, so the next dependent lane allocation conflicts; git restore dance only works once.
root_cause: Lane branches are not descendants of the mission tip after status writes.
suggested_fix: Merge the mission branch into the lane (establishes ancestry) instead of restore; tooling should do this automatically.

summary: A failed implement allocation left WPs in blocked; recovery required agent status emit --to planned --force since blocked->planned is an illegal unforced transition.
root_cause: Failed allocation transitions WP to blocked.
suggested_fix: Don't leave WPs blocked on allocation failure, or allow unforced blocked->planned recovery.

summary: Upstream issue #3387 cited dead code (_ARTIFACT_BUCKETS in snapshot.py:53-65) as the mechanism; live read showed _count_artifacts counts by directory membership. Lesson: a cited file:line is a starting point, not a substitute for reading live code.
root_cause: Issue author cited an unreferenced table.
suggested_fix: Remove dead _ARTIFACT_BUCKETS; verify cited line numbers during spec.

summary: FR-001 was re-scoped to docs-only because the legacy step-contract surface is retired by Accepted ADR 2026-08-13-1 (in unmerged PR #3378); a reviewer given only the spec text would re-derive the larger verdict — the ruling, not the FR prose, is the acceptance bar.
root_cause: Spec premise assumed ADR was unratified; ADR landing lagged its acceptance.
suggested_fix: Cite the binding ruling in Charter Check/IC map; land the ADR's implementation.

summary: validate_pack() gained check_drg_root=True with a narrow False carve-out for pack_assembler and org init scaffolds; a future third caller must reason about the default explicitly.
root_cause: Assembler and org-init produce drg/-fragment-only packs by design.
suggested_fix: Document default rationale for new callers.

summary: profile_skipped diagnostics are uniformly error severity because SkippedProfile carries no severity; finer-grained advisory skips need a doctrine-layer change.
root_cause: SkippedProfile lacks a severity field.
suggested_fix: Add severity to SkippedProfile if advisory skip classes are needed.

summary: spec-commit refused every attempt with 'Refusing to commit planning artifacts to the protected branch main' while on a feature branch; placement_ref sourced from meta.json target_branch frozen at specify time; next stayed at discovery. --target-branch did not help.
root_cause: Auto-commit path trusts stale meta.json target_branch over the CLI's own live branch-context resolver (SK-12/SK-13).
suggested_fix: Reconcile meta.json target_branch with live HEAD or give spec-commit a --to-branch escape hatch.

summary: Same stale-meta.json commit-refusal reproduced on plan --json (commit_status no_op_wrong_surface) and tasks --json (finalize_tasks); _resolve_mission_target_branch's own docstring names the bug. Worked around each time with safe-commit --to-branch.
root_cause: _resolve_mission_target_branch (core/paths.py:717) reads meta.json target_branch directly.
suggested_fix: Fix _resolve_mission_target_branch to honor live branch context.

summary: finalize_tasks silently dropped every SC-00x requirement ref from WP frontmatter (wps.yaml kept them) with no warning — a 'silent success' defect in the mission tooling itself.
root_cause: Requirement-ref parser/validator filters unrecognized SC-* prefix silently.
suggested_fix: Accept SC-* as a recognized prefix or warn when dropping unknown refs.

summary: finalize_tasks writes frontmatter, tasks.md, and lanes.json to disk before the commit attempt that then fails, leaving partial state.
root_cause: Write-then-commit ordering with no rollback.
suggested_fix: Make finalize-tasks transactional.

summary: A docs-only WP had to discover and run 'charter sync' and 'charter synthesize' from implement's error text before reaching its worktree; neither was in the brief or canonical loop.
root_cause: implement preflight gates on charter_source freshness and synthesized_drg presence.
suggested_fix: Don't gate docs-only WPs on charter/DRG freshness, or auto-run deterministic refresh.

summary: agent action implement materialized lane-a from main without the mission's artifacts (base-branch trap), then failed its own commit step with the stale-main refusal.
root_cause: Lane base resolved from stale target_branch main.
suggested_fix: Base lanes on the mission's live branch.

summary: implement --base reported exit-1 failure but had already created the correct workspace; failed prior command left uncommitted meta.json/frontmatter writes that blocked the next command (misleading failure + mutate-before-fail).
root_cause: Commit-step failure reported as overall command failure after side effects succeeded.
suggested_fix: Separate side-effect outcome from bookkeeping-commit outcome in reporting.

summary: The --base lane allocator minted a new sequential lane-b worktree for WP01, colliding with lanes.json's static lane-b (WP02-04), writing lane frontmatter into WP02 and leaving a live concurrent WP02 session sharing the same worktree/branch with no isolation.
root_cause: Dynamic sequential lane-slot allocation and static lanes.json WP-to-lane plan are two uncoordinated sources of lane identity.
suggested_fix: Reuse the WP's lanes.json-assigned lane_id on --base allocation.

summary: analysis_report_required / stale_analysis_report false positive: charter content hash unchanged, but a routine charter sync bumped metadata.yaml extracted_at, so the freshness gate reported stale charter. Corroborated three times.
root_cause: Analyze-freshness check gates on charter metadata timestamp rather than the raw-content hash it records.
suggested_fix: Compare recorded artifact content hashes, not metadata timestamps.

summary: agent tracer-append writes to a new traces/tooling-friction.md (untracked, different format) instead of the mission's tracer-tooling-friction.md — split-brain tracer surface; the stray file later blocked implement's 'Planning artifacts not committed' check.
root_cause: tracer-append target path diverges from the mission-root tracer file convention.
suggested_fix: Have tracer-append target the mission's actual tracer file.

summary: move-task and agent status emit refused with PROTECTED_BRANCH_REFUSED (destination ref main) even though branch-context resolves to the feature branch; WP lane-state stayed planned while work shipped (SK-21).
root_cause: Bookkeeping writer targets stale main rather than the resolved branch.
suggested_fix: Fix the to_lane transition commit target resolution.

summary: SK-21 blast radius is narrowed to the lane-state to_lane transition commit; mark-status annotation writes use a different path that succeeds but leaves files uncommitted.
suggested_fix: Fix surface is the to_lane transition commit, not all agent tasks bookkeeping.

summary: move-task --to for_review first required every subtask checked via mark-status, whose writes land uncommitted on the primary checkout and must be landed via safe-commit.
root_cause: mark-status writes without committing.

summary: implement preflight's charter synthesize fresh-project detector misfires on a populated repo (SK-14) and downgraded synthesis-manifest versions 3.2.6->3.2.5; resolved only by a concurrent sibling implement run mutating shared .kittify/charter state.
root_cause: Fresh-project detector misfire; shared governance state across lane implementers on one checkout.
suggested_fix: Fix SK-14 detector; avoid preflight mutating shared governance state.

summary: Agents on different lanes of the same mission share one repo-root checkout and observe each other's preflight side effects on .kittify/charter, including version downgrades — nondeterministic, timing-dependent.
root_cause: Shared checkout execution model.
suggested_fix: Isolate governance-state mutations from lane implementers.

summary: Fifteen-plus cumulative sightings of the SK-12/SK-14/SK-21 defect family across four WPs; each phase and WP rediscovered the same blockers and landed tool writes via safe-commit --to-branch.
root_cause: Stale meta.json target_branch root cause unfixed.
suggested_fix: Prioritize the stale target_branch fix; it dominates friction.

summary: Worktree status.json is not authoritative (status source of truth is the resolved surface), so WP02/WP03 showed planned locally despite orchestrator-reported approval; git history used as truth.
Plan produced verification-first: every load-bearing spec citation re-derived against live code; a real baseline (71 + 713 passed) captured rather than asserted.
root_cause: Spec review trail had already caught a stale line-number citation.

summary: A DRG NodeKind.GUARD primitive was rejected because ADR 2026-07-16-2 explicitly defers guards to a future epic; a dict registry fills the existing pattern.

Avoid flag-threaded strict/tolerant shared functions: make the strict path a separate function the real call site invokes, so a unit test on the flag can't pass while production never passes strict=True.
root_cause: Boolean-flag designs let tests pass while real call sites stay tolerant (SPEC-ARCH-001).
suggested_fix: Separate strict function called directly by _check_cli_guards.

summary: _canonical_meta_mission_type returns the first non-None of (mission_type, mission), so a blank mission_type silently falls through to the legacy key — 'two divergent meta readers' defect explicitly out of scope and unfixed.
root_cause: Legacy meta key fall-through in canonicalization.
suggested_fix: Fix the divergent meta readers in a follow-up mission.

summary: gather_artifact_presence scans a fixed _PRESENCE_FILE_TAGS 9-tuple lacking research.md; its docstring claims it mirrors all family reads, which silently breaks when a new family adds a tag.
root_cause: Hard-coded presence tag list not derived from guard tables.
suggested_fix: Derive presence tags from registered guard tables or add a coverage test.

summary: Rebase onto #3346 shifted cited line numbers non-uniformly (+105, +51, +23); citations had to be recomputed hunk-by-hunk and annotated, and this commit later re-staled the analyze gate.
root_cause: Design artifacts pin file:line coordinates that drift on every rebase.
suggested_fix: Prefer symbol-anchored citations over line numbers.

summary: specify minted no branch and left HEAD on main (SK-09), reproduced on lanes topology — not topology-specific; worked around by manual git checkout -b.
root_cause: specify does not create the mission branch.
suggested_fix: Have specify mint the mission branch.

summary: safe-commit refuses because HEAD isn't main while spec-commit refuses because branch 'is' main — contradictory refusals on the mission branch (SK-11); worked around with raw git commit.
root_cause: Two commit paths resolve target from stale meta.json with opposite checks.
suggested_fix: Unify commit placement resolution; honor live branch.

summary: A readiness-probe verification subagent never returned; spec-phase agent and R1 arch lens terminated on the org monthly spend limit; verify lens produced no artifact.
root_cause: Harness/billing limits.
suggested_fix: Disclose unfinished subagent work; don't restate unverified figures (issue's '~22 sites').

summary: Review lens wrote reviews/spec-gov.findings.yaml instead of the contract's dot-separated spec.gov.findings.yaml, harming cross-mission comparability.
root_cause: Squad agents don't follow artifact naming contract; no validator.
suggested_fix: Validate squad artifact filenames against the review overlay contract.

summary: finalize-tasks on a LANES topology with target_branch main refused with PROTECTED_BRANCH_REFUSED demanding a coordination branch that lanes topology doesn't have; placement layer (commit_router.py:437) and protection layer (policy.py:202) disagree.
root_cause: commit_router routes LANES bookkeeping to target_branch; policy.py refuses protected branches unconditionally with no topology awareness.
suggested_fix: Make the protection policy topology-aware or route LANES bookkeeping to the mission branch.

summary: The failed finalize-tasks run wrote uncommitted events, issue-matrix.json, and normalized frontmatter before refusing; that partial state itself blocked a clean re-run until committed.
root_cause: Mutate-before-fail without rollback.
suggested_fix: Transactional finalize-tasks.

summary: Recovery path: commit the partial state via safe-commit --to-branch, re-run finalize-tasks (full generation succeeds, only terminal commit fails), then land output with safe-commit --to-branch; bare safe-commit still resolves wrongly from meta.json.
suggested_fix: Always pass --to-branch explicitly.

summary: --target-branch flag's help scopes it to pre-WP07 legacy missions, so it isn't a documented remedy for current missions; agents escalate BLOCKED rather than guess.

record-analysis DIRTY_WORKTREE preflight refuses on any repo-wide dirty path (untracked _rnd/, deliberately-dirty charter files) though it commits only one file; no --allow-dirty flag; stash/pop workaround used three times.
root_cause: _enforce_analysis_report_write_preflight allowlists only self-bookkeeping churn.
suggested_fix: Scope the preflight to paths the command commits or add an escape hatch.

summary: A citation-only refresh commit re-staled the analyze gate because check_analysis_report_current gates on sha256 of spec/plan/tasks; semantically inert edits force a mission-wide re-analyze.
root_cause: Freshness gate is pure byte-hash equality.
suggested_fix: Allow a lightweight re-record or semantic-change detection.

summary: Aborted implement attempts left dirty files outside the WP's write scope (charter metadata, meta.json vcs lock, sibling WP01 task frontmatter) in the shared primary checkout, with no in-scope way to clear them.
root_cause: implement mutates shared checkout before gating; side effects not committed or rolled back.
suggested_fix: Gate before mutating; keep claim-side-effects scoped.

summary: implement refuses 'Planning artifacts must be committed on main' because WP planning_base_branch is main while all planning commits landed on the mission branch; no override.
root_cause: planning-branch vs mission-branch drift (SK-11); _print_planning_artifact_commit_instructions refuses when current != planning branch.

summary: implement chains stale-state gates one at a time (charter_source stale -> charter sync -> synthesized_drg missing -> charter synthesize) instead of naming all gaps up front.
root_cause: Preflight surfaces first failure only.
suggested_fix: Batch preflight diagnostics or auto-run deterministic remedies.

summary: charter synthesize stamped adapter/synthesizer_version 3.2.5 over 3.2.6 and dropped bundle_content_hash (downgrade), leaving deliberately-uncommitted dirty charter files that later tripped DIRTY_WORKTREE.
root_cause: Synthesis stamps a stale version literal / was run by a stale PATH CLI.
suggested_fix: Read running CLI version; fix SK-14 path.

summary: CLI version skew: record-analysis run by PATH 3.2.5 CLI hashed charter.md while the .venv 3.2.6rc2 checker hashes charter.yaml, producing a false stale_analysis_report (SK-20); next --json doesn't call the same check so it showed clear.
root_cause: _charter_path() resolution order changed between CLI versions; multiple installed CLIs.
suggested_fix: Pin _charter_path resolution independent of CLI version; record which file in schema.

summary: WP02's claim transition never recorded across any command (implement, agent action implement) due to LANES/main PROTECTED_BRANCH_REFUSED, while WP01 via a different entry point did; code was completed but status stayed planned.
root_cause: Two entry points route claim bookkeeping differently; policy.py unconditional refusal.
suggested_fix: Fix LANES bookkeeping destination resolution.

summary: next --json reported guard_failures [] while agent action implement still refused — next's clear verdict does not predict workspace-prep entry points.
root_cause: next does not run the same analyze freshness check.
suggested_fix: Make next run the same preflight gates as implement.

summary: A tracer entry was drafted from a stale copy of the tracer file inside the lane worktree (frozen at base_commit), misnumbering it; tracer files diverge across lane and mission checkouts.
root_cause: Tracers are mission-root files but agents work in lane worktrees with stale copies.
suggested_fix: Append tracers only on the mission-root checkout / via a CLI that targets it.

summary: Dispatch briefs twice mischaracterized blockers as resolved (theory that the bookkeeping gap was command-specific), leading to repeated re-dispatches that re-hit the same gate.
root_cause: Orchestrator inferred fix scope without reproducing.
suggested_fix: Reproduce before declaring a blocker resolved in a brief.

summary: _org_scan_dirs scanned only <org_root>/<plural>/built-in/, a layout no real org pack uses, so charter activate silently evicted every org-pack artifact; fixed additively with non-recursive flat scan matching the live loader.
root_cause: Activation scanner and live loader had divergent layout assumptions (two sources of truth).
suggested_fix: Keep scan layout parity with the live loader; red-first test at the operator level.

summary: Existing unit test TestOrgScanDirsHelper pinned the old buggy behaviour.
root_cause: Test encoded the defect.
suggested_fix: Extend tests to assert against the live loader layout.

summary: specify minted slug with -<mid8> suffix; dispatcher instructions using the bare slug path must resolve feature_dir from JSON output.
suggested_fix: Callers must read feature_dir/mission_slug from specify JSON.

summary: software-dev specify scaffolded an empty 0-byte spec.md with no template skeleton, unlike research/documentation types; agent copied structure from existing kitty-specs specs (against canonical-source guidance).
root_cause: No spec-template.md shipped for software-dev.
suggested_fix: Ship a software-dev spec template skeleton.

summary: single_branch topology set target_branch to protected main and minted no branch, so safe-commit refused; coord should be chosen regardless of size to get a non-protected branch (SK-09).
root_cause: single_branch topology targets the protected base branch directly.
suggested_fix: Warn/refuse single_branch on a protected base or have it mint a branch.

summary: No git identity configured in the container; safe_commit reported only 'git commit failed' with no detail.
root_cause: safe_commit swallows git's error output.
suggested_fix: Surface underlying git error text; preflight git identity.

summary: tasks-outline/tasks-packages are prompt template names, not CLI subcommands; the real CLI surface is context resolve / check-prerequisites / finalize-tasks / map-requirements — confusing for agents.
suggested_fix: Document the CLI surface backing the tasks phase in the templates.

summary: finalize-tasks flagged foreign FR-021 (cited in prose about another shipped mechanism) as unmapped; parse_requirement_ids_from_spec_md findall-s the whole document; no CLI escape hatch; operator authorized a tooling-forced spec.md edit.
root_cause: Whole-document regex scan, not scoped to the Functional Requirements table.
suggested_fix: Scope parsing to the ### Functional Requirements table rows.

summary: create_intent (for planned-new owned files) is not covered by tasks-outline/tasks-packages template schemas; discovered only from finalize-tasks error text.
root_cause: Template schema gap.
suggested_fix: Add create_intent to tasks template schemas.

summary: finalize-tasks commit refused as 'protected main' while HEAD was a PR branch; --target-branch (documented FR-012 escape hatch) did not change commit placement but mutated WP frontmatter and lanes.json target_branch before failing, leaving divergent state.
root_cause: Commit target read from stale meta.json (SK-13); --target-branch only affects frontmatter.
suggested_fix: Make --target-branch affect commit placement or not mutate on failure.

summary: lanes.json target_branch left disagreeing with meta.json after the failed --target-branch run; handed to implement phase as a known state item.
root_cause: Partial mutation across multiple generated files.

summary: record-analysis silently writes verdict unknown when the carrier schema is present but wrong (parse_structured_findings returns None); did not reproduce with a correct carrier but remains a silent-success defect.
root_cause: parse_structured_findings conflates 'no carrier' with 'wrong carrier'.
suggested_fix: Raise on present-but-wrong carriers.

summary: record-analysis DIRTY_WORKTREE guard checks the whole tree, so an unrelated untracked scratch dir blocks it; safe-commit's guard is narrower; worked around by mv-ing the dir out and back.
root_cause: Guard scope broader than its evident intent.
suggested_fix: Scope guard to the mission directory.

summary: A reviewer subagent ran concurrently in the same shared single_branch checkout during implementation, writing files and commits; implementer cannot assume exclusive working tree.
root_cause: single_branch topology has no lane worktree isolating implementer and reviewer.
suggested_fix: Isolate reviewer and implementer in separate worktrees.

summary: Moving a line in kind_vocabulary.py would have broken test_built_in_location_authority's _KNOWN_JOIN_ALLOWLIST, which pins joins by exact (file, lineno); no planning artifact listed this gate.
root_cause: Line-number-pinned architectural allowlists; planning gate sets didn't enumerate them.
suggested_fix: Planning should grep tests/architectural for line-pinned allowlists covering files being edited; prefer symbol-anchored pins.

summary: Never git stash on a shared non-worktree checkout: it stashed a concurrent reviewer's uncommitted edit; use read-only git show origin/main:<path> to attribute pre-existing failures.
root_cause: Shared checkout with concurrent agents.
suggested_fix: Use read-only inspection for baseline attribution.

summary: analysis-report.md input_artifacts carry absolute machine-local paths (collect_input_artifact_hashes stringifies absolutely); review YAMLs/tracers cited a local ledger by absolute path — unsafe for a public repo.
root_cause: collect_input_artifact_hashes uses absolute paths.
suggested_fix: Emit repo-relative paths; filed #3398.

summary: Local ledger IDs (SK-xx) are workspace-local; committed artifacts should cite upstream issue numbers (#3394, #3398).
suggested_fix: Cite upstream issues, not local ledger IDs, in committed artifacts.

summary: Canonical software-dev spec template lacks Clarifications, provenance, out-of-scope and sizing sections the operator brief required; they were bolted on around the mandatory core.
root_cause: Template sections don't match operator brief expectations.
suggested_fix: Add optional Clarifications/Out-of-scope/Sizing sections to the spec template.

summary: Operator-supplied file:line evidence had drifted (e.g. :49-50 vs :48-50, ~805 vs 789) and one docstring claim ('WP06' seam) was false as described.
root_cause: Line-number citations drift; docstrings stale.
suggested_fix: Re-verify citations in a read-only pass before writing them into specs.

summary: Making MissionTypeRepository.default() project-dependent behind its process-wide cls-keyed functools.cache would poison the cache across projects; a separate layered lookup keyed on (dirs, pack_context) was chosen.
root_cause: Project-blind cache key on a project-dependent value.
suggested_fix: Keep default() built-in-only; add a separately keyed cache with cache_clear test seam.

summary: Moving the action_sequence producer out of src/doctrine would red test_no_inert_schema_slots twice (new unaccounted slot + stale baseline row), constraining the design.
root_cause: Arch gate walks a fixed directory tree for schema-slot producers.

summary: Nested-vs-flat mission-type layout for the built-in tier remains undecided (#2468); a recursive project-layer scan could mint a bogus 'governance-profile' mission type.
root_cause: Built-in tier's nested layout inconsistent with flat convention elsewhere.
suggested_fix: Resolve nested-vs-flat under #2468; keep org/project flat and non-recursive.

summary: specify with coord topology minted the coordination branch but left HEAD on main with untracked scaffold files; spec-commit refused ('protected main') with a retry suggestion identical to the failing command.
root_cause: specify doesn't mint a primary feature branch for coord topology.
suggested_fix: Mint a primary branch at specify, or provide a retrofit command for existing missions.

summary: spec-commit --help promises 'materialize-then-retry' onto the coordination branch, but spec-kind artifacts are PRIMARY-partition and never transit coord (transit removed by FR-003/C-005); help text stale.
root_cause: Help text not updated after the planning->coord transit removal.
suggested_fix: Update spec-commit --help to reflect primary-partition kinds.

summary: Even after checking out a PR branch, spec-commit still refused: placement derives from meta.json target_branch main, blind to the live HEAD; plain git commit fallback was used.
root_cause: commit_router placement reads mission state, not the live git ref (SK-12).
suggested_fix: Honor live branch or allow updating target_branch via CLI.

summary: finalize-tasks whole-text FR-\d+ scan tripped on a foreign FR-032 inside a quoted ADR sentence; operator-authorized bracketed elision in spec.md to avoid fabricated traceability.
root_cause: _REF_FIND_PATTERN scans the whole spec with no table scoping or citation-marking convention.
suggested_fix: Scope parsing to the requirements table; add a citation-marking convention.

summary: When wps.yaml is present, finalize-tasks ignores its requirement_refs and reads only WP-file frontmatter; the tasks.md fallback is gated off, so all 13 FRs reported unmapped until map-requirements was run.
root_cause: _resolve_dependencies_and_refs reads deps from wps.yaml but refs only from frontmatter.
suggested_fix: Read requirement_refs from wps.yaml when present; file upstream.

summary: finalize-tasks warned about missing plan_concern_refs for a planning-only ADR WP; resolved by setting cross_cutting: true.
finalize-tasks full run succeeded at generation but failed at terminal commit on protected main (SK-13); landed via safe-commit --to-branch.
root_cause: Stale meta.json target_branch.

summary: finalize-tasks-generated lanes.json contained a real cyclic depends_on_lanes graph (lane-a<->lane-b, lane-a<->lane-c) after write_scope_overlap collapse; compute_lanes never validates lane-graph cycles (docstring admits best-effort).
root_cause: Collapse unions WPs by write-scope overlap without checking lane-level cycles.
suggested_fix: Validate the lane graph for cycles in compute_lanes before writing lanes.json.

summary: An earlier tracer/WP prompt authorized bypassing lane allocation to hand-construct a workspace — a doctrine violation caught by adversarial review (TASKS-FRESH-001).
root_cause: Overstated risk of the allocator's catch-up merge.
suggested_fix: Stay on canonical implement path; verify catch-up merge with merge-base --is-ancestor.

summary: record-analysis DIRTY_WORKTREE guard scoped to whole repo tripped on an untracked R&D scratch dir; mv-out/mv-back workaround.
root_cause: Guard over-scoped.
suggested_fix: Scope to mission dir.

summary: SK-06 triggers (wrong schema, missing leading --- fence, self-re-feed of record-analysis output) deliberately avoided in carrier construction; verdict ready was genuine.
root_cause: record-analysis silently degrades to verdict unknown on malformed carriers.
suggested_fix: Fix SK-06 silent downgrade paths (_split_carrier fence drop, legacy-shape rejection).

summary: Fresh worktree .venv had zero deps; uv run pytest did not auto-sync as CONTRIBUTING implies; explicit uv sync --frozen --all-extras was required before any test ran.
root_cause: Fresh worktree venv not populated; WP Gate Set assumed uv run works.
suggested_fix: Document/perform uv sync in worktree setup.

summary: analysis-report.md input_artifacts emitted with absolute paths by collect_input_artifact_hashes; reviewer rejected WP01 (sev 4) for local-path leakage; hand-rewritten to repo-relative.
root_cause: CLI stringifies absolute paths.

summary: Deleting dead resolve_mission_steps tripped test_no_dead_symbols (last facade re-export import) and test_golden_count_ban; plan claimed deletions could only help gates.
root_cause: Facade re-export liveness differs from overall symbol liveness; plan inferred instead of running gates.
suggested_fix: Run arch gates before asserting deletion safety in plan.md.

summary: Unowned pre-existing test file pinned the exact pre-fix bug as correct behaviour (TestResolveLayerCandidate asserting None); WP write-scope isolation forced leaving it red until integration re-pin.
root_cause: Planning owned_files didn't include tests encoding the bug.
suggested_fix: Planning should grep for tests exercising the changed function.

summary: ci-quality.yml diff-cover --include 'src/doctrine/*' uses filesystem glob (single * = one segment), silently excluding nested files, so the 90% critical-path gate gives almost no signal for src/doctrine and src/charter.
root_cause: diff_cover _is_excluded uses glob.glob; critical_paths use single-star package patterns.
suggested_fix: Change critical_paths to 'src/<pkg>/**/*.py'.

summary: test_no_dead_symbols reds when a WP ships a seam ahead of its caller; resolved by leaving the symbol out of __all__ with a NOTE for the follow-up WP.
root_cause: Dead-symbol gate requires live src caller for every __all__ entry.
suggested_fix: Gate-sequencing guidance for seam-first WPs.

summary: Tests mocking internal call shapes via sys.modules injection and cache priming broke on a correct repository-call swap; two unowned test files had to be fixed in place.
root_cause: Tests coupled to implementation/mocking strategy rather than contract.
suggested_fix: Prefer contract-level tests over sys.modules injection.

summary: Thread per-id source-layer provenance through resolve_layered_mission_types rather than every caller re-deriving it (WP06 added a local mirror helper).
root_cause: Factory returns plain dict without provenance.
suggested_fix: Return provenance from the roster factory.

summary: Coverage runs took 26-27 min (2.5-3x baseline) due to concurrent missions on the same host; a wall-clock budget test failed once then passed alone.
root_cause: Host CPU contention from parallel missions.
suggested_fix: Classify as host-load noise; run timing tests serially.

summary: doctrine census FACADE-ONLY disposition forced widening charter.missions re-exports and _FACADE_TABLE outside the WP's owned_files.
root_cause: CLI may only reach doctrine via charter facades.
suggested_fix: Plan should anticipate facade widening per WP.

summary: mypy per-file vs batch invocation disagree: casts needed for per-file (follow_imports=skip) show as redundant-cast in batch; 18 pre-existing batch errors across 9 files tolerated because CI mypy is advisory.
root_cause: charter.* follow_imports=skip override inconsistent with batch mode.
suggested_fix: Align mypy config so per-file and batch agree; make batch mypy clean.

summary: Pre-spec squad (corpus-mapper + breadth grep) surfaced the non-obvious two-gate structure; grounded spec instead of guessing globs.
suggested_fix: Keep pre-spec investigation squads for CI-config work.

summary: CI silently skipped corpus suites on data-only PRs (packs/kitty-specs/.kittify not in on.paths) — a false-green with no signal that a class of tests never ran.
root_cause: Trigger allowlist (Gate 0) omitted data paths; dorny group (Gate 1) separately missing.
suggested_fix: Add discrete trigger globs and a corpus dorny group + blocking fast-tests-corpus job.

summary: Two-gate structure non-discoverable without a code trace; a naive dorny-group-only fix would look right but be inert.
root_cause: Workflow trigger paths and dorny filters are separate layers.

summary: Arch-invariant gates (test_ci_quality_path_filters, test_ci_collection_completeness) run only in CI's integration-core-misc job, not fast local suites, so path-filter regressions pass locally.
root_cause: Arch gates excluded from fast local tier.
suggested_fix: Run these tests/architectural files locally before pushing CI changes.

summary: GitHub on.paths does not support {a,b} brace expansion (dorny does); brace form would have made the #3008 fix match nothing (squad blocker B1).
root_cause: Syntax mismatch between GitHub path filters and dorny filters.
suggested_fix: Use discrete globs in on.paths.

summary: Avoid double-running corpus suites: mark corpus tests with @pytest.mark.corpus and run fast-tests-corpus with -m corpus rather than whole dirs.
root_cause: Whole-dir runs overlap with existing jobs.
suggested_fix: Marker-based corpus selection (M1).

summary: Hand-adding a corpus row to ci_topology_census.json would red test_ci_topology_worklist because the census is auto-derived; register like the docs precedent instead.
root_cause: Census is derived from live src tree.
suggested_fix: Follow docs group precedent (M2).

summary: Diff-scoped docs checks must derive changed files from base.sha with fetch-depth 0 and fail closed on an empty changed-set; keep unfiltered push:main backstop; co-evolve docs-freshness and rulers guards.
root_cause: relative_link_fixer and related_validator have no diff concept.
suggested_fix: Explicit base-ref, fail-closed empty set (M3/M5).

summary: Add a corpus completeness invariant asserting every path a corpus-marked test reads is matched by trigger globs, so #3008 can't silently reopen.
suggested_fix: New completeness invariant (M4).

summary: Spec conflated 'blocking' senses: docs-freshness is not a required check (wiring it into quality-gate.needs would leave non-docs PRs pending forever) whereas the corpus gate is blocking.
root_cause: Terminology overload of 'blocking'.
suggested_fix: Distinguish required vs red-X checks in spec language.

summary: Fold candidate #3265: orchestrator-boundary.yml and doctrine-charter-tests.yml lack an unfiltered push:main backstop (same class).
root_cause: Path-filtered workflows without push backstop.
suggested_fix: Evaluate #3265 for fold; keep #3127 separate.

summary: Plan referenced a nonexistent .kittify/skills/** dir; acceptance-matrix.json has no committed reader.
root_cause: Plan globs not verified against the tree.
suggested_fix: Drop nonexistent paths.

summary: Fresh full parallel pytest: one worker held .pytest_cache/spec-kitty-test-venv.lock during editable install; siblings timed out and cascaded setup errors.
root_cause: Shared test-venv bootstrap lock under xdist.
suggested_fix: Red-first repair of bootstrap; manual prewarm meanwhile (#3283).

summary: Whole suite collects 37,444 nodes in 94-110s even for narrow marker discovery.
root_cause: Full collection needed for marker selection.
suggested_fix: Freeze collection baseline; explicit route manifests.

summary: spec-kitty CLI repository scan makes some commands take ~20-60s; help output embeds long command docs.
root_cause: Repository scan on invocation.
suggested_fix: Speed up CLI startup scan.

summary: CI mutation job is disabled, so mutation evidence required focused local changed-cluster probes.
root_cause: Mutation CI job disabled.
suggested_fix: Re-enable mutation job or provide local recipe.

summary: setup-plan auto-commit returned no_op_wrong_surface citing persisted protected main despite current PR planning branch; manual commit required.
root_cause: Persisted target_branch main vs live branch.

summary: Healthy full baseline: 24 failed, 2 errors out of 37,298 passed in 1,689s; #3284 filed for 23 failures + 2 errors, #2782 already tracked.
root_cause: Pre-existing baseline reds on main.
suggested_fix: Resolve #3284 before baseline acceptance.

summary: WP01 review cycles were committed byte-identically on both PRIMARY and COORD, with cycle-4 dirty on COORD — review authority split-brain.
root_cause: Review artifacts written to two partitions.
suggested_fix: Single SSOT (COORD) for review artifacts.

summary: cutover-guard required PRIMARY seed evidence while topology-aware cutover writes status seeds to COORD — surface divergence.
root_cause: Guard and cutover disagree on status seed surface.
suggested_fix: Align cutover-guard with topology-aware seed placement.

summary: PRIMARY .venv broken after interrupted install (pytest namespace-only, pip missing modules); rebuilt with uv sync --frozen --all-extras --reinstall.
root_cause: Interrupted install corrupted venv.

summary: Prior squad PASS claims existed only as prose and analysis next-actions referenced cycle 1; grounding report had to be persisted.
root_cause: Squad verdicts not persisted as artifacts.
suggested_fix: Persist squad reports as files with point-in-time scope.

summary: Design: fixed route universe and dual timing metrics prevent route deletion/rename from manufacturing savings; migration deletion needs a compatibility matrix.
Stopped before WP01 approval after a three-lens grounding squad reproduced route-provenance and exact-outcome evidence gaps; no deletion proceeds on an unapproved foundation.
Research-squad-first grounding found issue bodies undercounted the facade surface (10 not 8), consumers (8 not 6), and missed 4 collateral imports.
root_cause: Issue bodies drift from code.
suggested_fix: Ground issues against upstream/main before speccing.

summary: Read-only fencing of scout agents (no git checkout/stash on the shared working tree) avoided HEAD-detach hazards.
suggested_fix: Fence scouts read-only.

summary: #3216 was folded based on its issue body but its target had already been retired by a prior mission (#3245); descoped and closed during post-tasks squad.
root_cause: Fold premise grounded on issue body, not current code.
suggested_fix: Verify each fold's premise against current code before committing scope.

summary: Pre-merge squad found 3 aggregate-only census-fixture staleness defects no per-lane run could see; one (closure-cascade demotion) was caught only by running the census on the consolidated tree.
root_cause: Full tests/architectural not run per-lane; lanes froze fixtures against base while another lane mutated census-scope code.
suggested_fix: Run the live census on the consolidated tree pre-merge; check closure chains when extracting ctor helpers.

summary: spec-commit returned committed:false 'unchanged' on a real 166-line untracked diff; safe_commit's stash/restore dance mangled the index when pre-staged, leaving a dangling stash.
root_cause: safe_commit pre-commit stash/restore mishandles untracked/pre-staged files.
suggested_fix: File upstream gap; fix safe_commit stash dance.

summary: pre-commit hook pinned an ephemeral agent-worktree venv interpreter that no longer existed, failing every commit.
root_cause: Hook installer pins the interpreter of whichever venv installed it.
suggested_fix: Pin a stable interpreter (repo .venv) in the hook installer.

summary: Rebasing the mission branch after the coord branch existed stranded coord on the old base; lane creation conflicted across a 39-commit divergence; fixed with rebase --onto plus merging the planning commit into coord.
root_cause: Coord branch base not updated when primary rebased.
suggested_fix: Don't rebase after coord exists, or provide a CLI re-strand command.

summary: Issue-matrix approval gate blocks every per-WP approval until all spec-referenced issues (discovered set larger than tabled) have verdicts; deferred needs Follow-up: #NNN; finalize clobbers the matrix, so populate after finalize.
root_cause: Issue-matrix gate scoped to WP approval; finalize regenerates the matrix.
suggested_fix: Don't clobber issue-matrix on finalize; document ordering.

summary: Pre-review regression gate has a hardcoded 300s CAPTURE_BASELINE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, failing for_review on broad WPs even when tests pass; skipped via SPEC_KITTY_SYNC_DISABLE=1 (sync-residue vocabulary, since retired from this gate per #3980).
root_cause: Non-tunable internal timeout.
suggested_fix: Make the gate timeout env-overridable.

summary: accept needs a contracts/ dir and every FR marked via acceptance-verdict; a descoped FR left a stale pending row.
root_cause: Acceptance matrix not updated on descope.
suggested_fix: Auto-retire descoped FRs from acceptance matrix.

summary: Dispatched implementers hit their turn limit on the slow move-task gate and loop; orchestrator must run the transition from the lane worktree.
root_cause: Slow move-task gate vs subagent turn limits.
suggested_fix: Speed up the gate or move transitions to orchestrator.

summary: Issue #3108 and the #3030 egress inventory (E20) asserted local_service sends to Jira/Linear and that sync.enabled:false still pushes titles to Jira — both false at bb2020fea; mission reframed.
root_cause: Dossier described stale or pre-reflow behaviour; claims not measured.
suggested_fix: Measure issue premises with positive controls before scoping.

summary: Every refusal probe needs a positive control distinguishing 'gate refused' from 'harness never reached the code'.
root_cause: Assertions of absence establish nothing without controls.
suggested_fix: Include positive controls in all refusal tests.

summary: One key (sync.enabled) answered two questions (hosted SaaS vs operator's own tracker), and the beads/fp local tracker path had zero consent gating; its only gate was the SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC arming flag.
root_cause: Consent chain built for hosted-sync leak, never separated.
suggested_fix: Separate tracker consent (Channel 2); gate local path at _build_engine.

summary: Egress guard AST scanner scopes subprocess out by design and cannot allowlist files without a sink; all-positional call evasion (#3113) noted with controls.
Evidence-base drafts contained measured errors later corrected (pull ships titles — false; ConsentLevel 6 members — actually 5).
root_cause: Drafted from reading rather than measuring.
suggested_fix: Correct in place with dated CORRECTION notes.

summary: Accepted breaking change: every existing beads/fp binding stops working on upgrade without a committed consent record, since nothing in src writes the project-local sync.enabled key.
root_cause: Deny-on-absence applied to local path.
suggested_fix: Refusal message with remedy, changelog, upgrade note.

summary: Largest residual: whether bd/fp binaries make network calls is unresolvable from this repo; executable name is operator-overridable from a machine-global credential file.
Live incidental bug: LocalTrackerService.sync_publish does not exist so tracker sync publish on beads/fp raises AttributeError, uncaught by _run_or_exit — file it, do not absorb.
root_cause: Delegation without method on local backend.
suggested_fix: File a bug.

summary: Import-rebinding: from X import f binds by value, so tests must patch the deciding module's name, not the defining module's; measured per site.
root_cause: Python import semantics.
suggested_fix: Patch at the consumer module.

summary: #3030 dossier disagreed with code in 6 places (stale line numbers, FR status 'Open' when implemented, mis-titled C-003 quoted in ~24 source comments).
root_cause: Dossier and source comments drift from code.
suggested_fix: Quote clauses not IDs; refresh dossier.

summary: Post-specify 4-lens squad returned 4x REJECT with high independent convergence (3/3, 4/4) on blocker findings — the squad earned its cost.
suggested_fix: Keep independent parallel lenses for high-risk specs.

summary: Default doctrine_mode external_authoritative means SyncEngine.push never calls create_issue, so the positive control would be vacuous; fixtures must pin spec_kitty_authoritative.
root_cause: Ownership mode silently skips pushes.
suggested_fix: Pin ownership mode in fixtures.

summary: Existing tests patch out _build_engine (the chokepoint holding the gate); mutation-as-plugin showed gate bind count 0 with 519 passing — vacuous all-green.
root_cause: House test pattern mocks the gated seam.
suggested_fix: Install recorder at SubprocessCommandRunner.run; assert non-zero gate bind counter.

summary: The SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC arming gate made every refusing assertion green with no gate built.
root_cause: Arming gate aborts tracker group before the path under test.
suggested_fix: Set arming explicitly and assert refusal text, plus negative pin.

summary: tracker bind and unbind erase a committed egress_refused key (payload-level rewrite; clear_tracker_config deletes the tracker block) — silent fail-open.
root_cause: save_tracker_config rebuilds the tracker block from a fresh config.
suggested_fix: Carry _extra forward; a refusal outlives its binding.

summary: sync doctor mis-renders refusals (discards text, labels readable files UNREADABLE, prints 'NOT a missing consent record' unconditionally).
root_cause: Readability renderer reused for verdicts.
suggested_fix: New verdict renderer.

summary: Chain B (repo-slug-keyed [sync.repo_defaults] via is_sync_enabled_for_checkout) still live on real egress gates despite being refused by the consent module; follow-up issue to be filed.
root_cause: Second consent answerer never removed.
suggested_fix: File follow-up to remove Chain B (now moot if sync transport retired).

summary: Refusing projects still read the credential store and create a SQLite tracker store before the gate (pre-gate local side effects).
suggested_fix: Don't mistake zero argv for zero effects.

summary: This mission's consent model is built on the sync transport (sync doctor, sync.enabled, SPEC_KITTY_ENABLE_SAAS_SYNC) that was deleted in August 2026; its findings are largely historical residue now.
root_cause: Sync transport retired.
suggested_fix: Re-audit tracker egress gating against the Zeitgeist-era code.

summary: A user-site editable .pth made bare python3 imports of specify_cli resolve to a different checkout concurrently edited by another mission; pytest was safe only because pytest.ini sets pythonpath=src.
root_cause: Editable install in user site-packages shared across checkouts.
suggested_fix: Set PYTHONPATH=<clone>/src for any non-pytest probe; avoid user-site editable installs.

summary: A single trivial test took 69s wall-clock, almost all import/collection cost.
root_cause: Heavy import/collection fixed cost per invocation.
suggested_fix: Budget for collection cost; reduce import-time work.

summary: Only Python 3.14 installed locally while CI runs 3.11/3.12, so every local green is a 3.14 green; Path.exists() on EACCES returns False on 3.14 but raises on 3.11, landing on the mission's own edge case.
root_cause: Interpreter behaviour divergence; local env lacks CI interpreters.
suggested_fix: Run touched tests under uv venv --python 3.11 and quote results.

summary: pytest.ini addopts lacks --timeout, so a hung suite consumes the run instead of failing (pytest-timeout is installed but unused globally).
root_cause: Missing global timeout in addopts.
suggested_fix: Add --timeout to pytest.ini addopts.

summary: decision widen interpolates an unvalidated decision_id raw into the request URL (only a help string asserts ULID-ness); --mission-slug accepted but ignored on the live path; consent laundering across projects possible.
root_cause: No input validation; ownership encoded positionally only.
suggested_fix: Validate at CLI boundary with one existing ULID regex; within-checkout ownership search.

summary: Mission brief named a nonexistent command (spec-kitty decision widen; real is hidden spec-kitty agent decision widen).
root_cause: Brief not checked against CLI tree.

summary: Merging the two attribution guards could halve coverage in four ways (single global scanned counter, attribution vocab widening, predicate strictness, CI routing) while staying green.
root_cause: Guard non-vacuity asserts a single global count.
suggested_fix: Per-class floors plus witness-shape assertions.

summary: test_seam_allowances_name_a_live_seam is a plain substring test over the whole file, so deleting the call leaves the import satisfying it; the text is protected, not the call.
root_cause: Substring-based seam allowance gate.
suggested_fix: Assert the seam behaviourally (drive transport into refusal).

summary: Mission framing referenced import-linter, which isn't configured; layering gates are pytest files.
register_saas_client_factory has no production caller and a stale docstring ('Called once at sync package startup' false since FR-032); kept as a pinned documented refusal seam (D-1).
root_cause: Write side of seam dead; docstring stale.
suggested_fix: Fix docstring; pin export; revisit if propagator egress branch removed.

summary: #3113: egress boundary guard's _transmits_a_body reads only node.keywords, so all-positional transport calls evade detection.
root_cause: AST predicate ignores positional args.
suggested_fix: Consider node.args in _transmits_a_body.

summary: Blast radius spanned four dorny CI groups; registering a new named group is a 5-edit atomic registration.
root_cause: CI routing tied to per-directory dorny groups.
suggested_fix: Prefer neutral placement or dual-glob membership; budget registration.

summary: A PR confined to src/specify_cli/tracker/** does not run the tracker attribution guard today (tests/sync only runs on the sync group; core-misc ignores tests/sync); none of the 4 SaasClient construction sites live under saas_client/**, so a cli-only diff skips the SaaS guard.
root_cause: Guard routing keyed on package names rather than construction-site locations.
suggested_fix: Re-key guard routing on construction-site locations via _gate_coverage (follow-up).

summary: Adding a module only to core_misc makes routing worse than run_all: fast-tests-sync (the only runner of tests/sync/tracker) stops running; module must be added to both sync and core_misc.
root_cause: core-misc shard --ignore=tests/sync.
suggested_fix: Dual-glob membership; tracker/** should join sync group too.

summary: CI observation to verify routing is structurally unobtainable pre-merge: stacked PRs on mission branches don't trigger CI Quality (on.pull_request.branches filters base ref), and editing ci-quality.yml confounds core_misc.
root_cause: Workflow branch filter plus ci-quality.yml being a core_misc member.
suggested_fix: Accept routing verification as post-merge.

summary: Nine CORE modules already reach specify_cli.sync transitively through unclassified packages, green under the integration-boundary gate (which checks direct imports only).
root_cause: Integration boundary gate is not transitive.
suggested_fix: Separate mission for transitive-reach scan; 'do not add a tenth'.

summary: Autouse conftest fixtures in tests/specify_cli/saas_client and tests/sync/tracker inject a consenting project_root whenever the kwarg is omitted, fabricating consent for inline-constructed clients; safety held by luck (from_env always passes project_root=None).
root_cause: Directory-level autouse fixtures arrange test premises.
suggested_fix: Runtime assertion that the built client carries the on-disk root; name conftest as falsifier.

summary: Squad lens measured Q6's 'no precedent' premise false: tests/architectural/_gate_coverage.py already parses dorny filters and job gating — prior art the spec author missed.
root_cause: Author didn't search existing arch tooling.
suggested_fix: Grep arch helpers before claiming no precedent.

summary: A P0 egress-consent boundary had zero presence in docs/adr/3.x or docs/context — rationale lived only in mission-local tracers no maintainer reads; ADR folded into mission.
root_cause: Boundary rationale recorded only in mission tracers.
suggested_fix: Write an ADR for structural boundaries.

summary: 'Engagement' was load-bearing and operator-facing but absent from docs/context glossary (DIR-032).
root_cause: Term not in terminology authority.
suggested_fix: Define term in docs/context.

summary: Round-1 spec: 13 of 29 requirements passable by literal no-op; SC-001 vacuous-passable with zero production change (never said 'consenting'); unauthenticated fixtures also yield zero requests.
root_cause: Acceptance criteria written without positive controls.
suggested_fix: Label [build]/[ratchet]; bind positive controls to same fixture.

summary: Undeclared no-op criteria converged 45% -> 18% -> 6% over three rounds; [build]/[ratchet]/folded labelling was the highest-value structural change.
suggested_fix: Adopt [build]/[ratchet] labels in spec templates.

summary: Spec grew 526 -> 1001 -> 1444 -> 1571 lines with four-fold duplication; only ~470 lines operative; a stale duplicate anchor already caused self-contradiction (RM-2); length goal not met.
root_cause: Remediation rounds add justification without consolidating.
suggested_fix: Add 'How to use this document' note; one canonical home per fact.

summary: Escalation gate tripped after 3 spec review rounds with 2 HIGH; operator accepted closing fixes unreviewed — least-scrutinised text in the spec.
root_cause: 3-round cap rule.
suggested_fix: Carry unreviewed-fix risk explicitly into handoff.

summary: Three orchestrator rulings were overturned by measurement (SaaS non-match pin would have red-flagged a coverage gain; Q6 fallback; D-3 ground); carried so they are not re-proposed.
suggested_fix: Record overturned rulings with measurements.

summary: from X import f binds by value: identity assertions detect stale bindings but never make a one-name patch effective; package re-export created a fourth name that made mutations inert and undetected; resolved with a plain module egress.py.
root_cause: Python by-value import binding (rot-mode 5).
suggested_fix: Patch every name; assert binding identity; avoid package re-exports for mutated symbols.

summary: Guard predicates are inline in test function bodies, so mutation plugins can't patch them and synthetic assertions would re-implement a second drifting copy.
root_cause: Guard logic not importable.
suggested_fix: Hoist predicates to module-level functions called by both live scan and synthetic tests.

summary: Count-based acceptance (scanned=4/3, unattributed=0) proven blind to predicate widening/narrowing; add synthetic witness shapes to before/after evidence.
root_cause: Live corpus lacks the discriminating shapes.
suggested_fix: Record (matched, attributed) for four witness shapes.

summary: Line anchors repeatedly wrong/regressed across lenses and remediations (store.py :63 vs :64; INTEGRATION_PREFIXES :74-80 vs :75-81).
root_cause: Line-number citations duplicated across many copies.
suggested_fix: Cite symbols; keep one canonical copy.

summary: Control-your-diagnostic: a passing control is not one that can detect the specific error mode (TYPE_CHECKING import nearly mis-read as runtime edge).
suggested_fix: Design controls that discriminate the anticipated error mode.

summary: Out-of-scope follow-ups filed rather than absorbed: ConsentedBatch extension to both transports, general guard-routing re-key, transitive CORE->sync reach scan, cross-checkout search (FU-4), FU-7, FU-8 (mod.SaasClient.from_env unguarded).
suggested_fix: File and track follow-up issues.

summary: This mission's subject (sync consent chain, SaaS egress refusal) is largely sync-transport residue deleted in August 2026; findings should be re-validated against current code.
root_cause: Sync transport retired.
